WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2025-12-15' AS start_date, DATE '2025-12-23' AS end_date
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT n.business_date, n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS web_net_sales,
       (SELECT c.net_sales FROM rpt_daily_store_sales c WHERE c.business_date = n.business_date AND c.store_id = 900) AS control
FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params
WHERE n.store_id = 900
  AND n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date,
       dayname(CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) AS dow,
       status, fulfilment_type, COUNT(*) AS orders, COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS distinct_orders, SUM(line_count) AS lines
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE dispatch_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-10' AND dispatch_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-28'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,3,4;

WITH o AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, line_count, status, order_ts_utc, dispatch_ts_utc
  FROM fact_web_order
  WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
    AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23'
),
l AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, COUNT(*) AS n_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT line_no) AS n_distinct_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS n_ids,
         SUM(net_amount) AS net, SUM(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS staff
  FROM fact_sales_line WHERE receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM o) GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.receipt_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_lines,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.n_lines <> o.line_count THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linecount_mismatch,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.n_lines <> l.n_distinct_lines OR l.n_lines <> l.n_ids THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dup_lines,
       SUM(l.n_lines) AS total_lines, SUM(l.net) AS total_net,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-10' AND DATE '2025-12-23' GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS dup_sales_line_ids,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT return_line_id FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23' GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS dup_return_ids
FROM o LEFT JOIN l ON l.receipt_id = o.web_order_id;

WITH wd AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dd
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
)
SELECT 'sales' AS kind, s.store_id, p.category = 'ZZ Test' AS is_test, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(f.net_amount) AS amt
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN wd ON wd.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE wd.dd BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23' GROUP BY ALL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'return_on_web_sales_line_in_window', s.store_id, p.category = 'ZZ Test', COUNT(*), SUM(r.refund_net)
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23' AND (s.store_id = 900 OR r.sales_line_id IN (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_code='WB' OR channel_id IS NOT NULL))
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY 1,2;

SELECT r.return_date, (s.store_id = 900) AS booked_to_web, (f.receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order)) AS orig_is_web_order, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(r.refund_net) AS refund_net
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23'
GROUP BY ALL HAVING booked_to_web OR orig_is_web_order ORDER BY 1,2,3;

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, f.net_amount AS sold, 0 AS refunded
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, 0, r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT business_date, SUM(sold) AS sold, SUM(refunded) AS refunded, SUM(sold) - SUM(refunded) AS web_net_sales
FROM net_lines
WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
